fixes.explanation: Camel's hair! You dressed those witnesses like you had a big budget and a lot of nerve. But this verse says the two witnesses will prophesy for 1,260 days, “…clothed in sackcloth.” (Revelation 11:3) No camel on that label, friend.

A third does show up elsewhere in this book (Revelation 8:7), but not in this verse. Here the text says “…a tenth of the city collapsed.” (Revelation 11:13) So tenth is the word. Always check which verse you're standing in.
